_note: For each archetype: 3 sample prompts (2 targets, 1 adversarial) and 3 trigger recipes (wide / sharp / narrow). Each recipe declares which prompts it fires on, so the teaching moment is deterministic. Wording is plain: this is the SKILL.md `description` field that tells Claude when to run the skill.

samplePrompts.text: Place a house in the village square.
Build a cozy cottage where I'm standing.
Find every place we call the fetchUser function.

recipes.label: Too Broad
recipes.description: Use this skill whenever the user asks for help with anything in the codebase.
recipes.lesson: Claude will run this skill too often — even for things it isn't for.

recipes.label: Just Right
recipes.description: Use this skill when the user asks to place or build a house in the Claude Code RPG village.
recipes.lesson: Claude runs it only when it fits.

recipes.label: Too Specific
recipes.description: Use this skill only when the user asks for a thatched-roof cottage in the village square.
recipes.lesson: Too specific — Claude misses cases this skill should handle.
